add_model_record_hook: add a forward hook to a PyTorch model to record all submodule inputs and outputs during a forward pass
compare_hook_items: compare two model record hooks and yield module-level input and output tensor differences between them
print_hook_items: print the recorded inputs and outputs with tensor norms for each submodule from a model record hook
print_hook_items_difference: print the input and output tensor differences between two model record hooks with an optional print limit
ModelRecordHook_get_items_dict: get a dictionary of recorded items keyed by module name from a ModelRecordHook instance after a forward pass
